summary: This clinical trial is testing a drug called inclisiran in children aged 2 to less than 12 years with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, an inherited condition causing very high cholesterol. The study compares the test drug against a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine. This is a Phase 3 study with 9 participants sponsored by Novartis Pharmaceuticals. The trial is currently recruiting participants.
